title: Star Wars: The Force Unleashed
notes: Each level's achievement unlocks when the next level starts loading.
Read-only: Vault watches the game's memory and never changes it. Ultimate Sith Edition, Steam.
Level numbers come from the community speedrun auto-splitter.

testGuide.title: Start the story
testGuide.detail: Start a new game. "Current level number" should show 2 during the Kashyyyk prologue.

testGuide.title: Finish the prologue
testGuide.detail: When the next level loads, "Vader's Fury" should pop up.

achievements.title: Vader's Fury
achievements.description: Finish the Kashyyyk prologue as Darth Vader.

achievements.title: The Secret Apprentice
achievements.description: Finish the training room on the Empirical.

achievements.title: TIE Fighter Factory
achievements.description: Finish the TIE fighter construction facility on Nar Shaddaa.

achievements.title: Raxus Prime
achievements.description: Defeat Kazdan Paratus on Raxus Prime.

achievements.title: The Empirical
achievements.description: Survive the attack on the Empirical.

achievements.title: Imperial Raxus Prime
achievements.description: Pull down the Star Destroyer at Raxus Prime.

achievements.title: The Death Star
achievements.description: Finish the final battle on the Death Star.

achievements.title: Unlimited Power
achievements.description: Start a New Game+ run with your powers carried over.
